span.p: Lessons from Production: Vertical Scaling Framework

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Signal Warning at Action
Cache hit ratio under 90% Add RAM / cache
Disk queue depth > 2x disk count Upgrade I/O
Connection pool wait > 100ms Increase pool
P99 latency trend +5ms/month Investigate now

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Rule 2: Vertical Scaling Is Not Binary

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Per-service choice:
Bounded data + ACID ──> Vertical (payments, profiles)
Unbounded data ──> Horizontal (logs, messages)
Read-heavy + known WS ──> Vertical + cache (dashboards)
Write-heavy + spike ──> Horizontal (feeds, events)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Largest instance capacity: [RAM, vCPU, IOPS]
Current consumption: [RAM, vCPU, IOPS]
Growth rate: [per month]
Months to ceiling: [capacity / growth]
Action: If under 18 months, start horizontal migration

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Rule 4: Plan the Migration Before You Hit the Ceiling

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Discord: 18 months to shard MongoDB
Atlassian: Multi-year to Jira Data Platform
Uber: 2 years to microservices
Lead time: Start 6+ months before ceiling hit

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Adding Redis is cheaper than a major instance upgrade
Typical cache ROI: 80-95% DB load reduction
Cost: Redis on r7g.xlarge = $147/month
Vs: DB instance upgrade r7g.4xlarge to r7g.8xlarge =
$588/month increase. Cache first saves $441/month.
